paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Consultant role on Optum Finance's planning and reporting team in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I like that this role works across Finance, Product, Operations and Technology and owns the forecasting tools and month-end story that leaders rely on.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and helped streamline the order-to-cash process, cutting the cash conversion cycle by 20%.
That lines up with the planning, forecasting and month-end reporting your team runs, and with building models that hold up in a large organization. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
